intro.title: Risk Management
paragraphs: You step through a door looking for the restroom, but instead find yourself in a dimly lit janitor's closet.
Concrete floors, cluttered shelves, and the faint buzz of a faulty electrical cable greet you. This place is a hazard waiting to happen.
Your task: identify every risk in this room and then assess them using a proper risk matrix. Let's get started!

dialogues.enterRoom: Hold on... This isn't the restroom.
dialogues.realizeCloset: This must be the janitor's closet.
dialogues.unsafeRoom: This is the most unsafe room I have ever seen!
dialogues.zoomCable: Look at that frayed cable... sparks are flying!
dialogues.zoomBoxes: Those boxes are stacked way too high... they're tilting!
dialogues.zoomPuddle: There's a puddle on the floor. Someone could slip!
dialogues.uncoverRisks: I better uncover all the risks before someone gets hurt!
dialogues.allRisksFound: I've identified all the risks in this room! Now I need to assess each one properly. Let me head to the whiteboard.
dialogues.startAssessment: Time to assess each risk using a likelihood and impact scale. Let me think carefully about each one.
dialogues.assessmentComplete: I've completed the risk assessment! Let me review my work.
dialogues.congratulations: Excellent work! The risk assessment is complete. This room is no longer a mystery - every hazard has been identified and evaluated. Time to get out of here!

cable.name: Frayed Electrical Cable
cable.thought: That cable is frayed and sparking! It could start a fire or electrocute someone.
cable.description: A frayed electrical cable with visible sparks, posing fire and electrocution hazards.

extinguisher.name: Blocked Fire Extinguisher
extinguisher.thought: The fire extinguisher is blocked by that ladder. It should always be accessible in case of emergency.
extinguisher.description: A fire extinguisher blocked by a ladder, making it inaccessible in an emergency.

ladder.name: Unstable Ladder
ladder.thought: That ladder looks unstable. Someone could fall if they tried to climb it.
ladder.description: An unstable ladder leaning against the wall, risk of falling.

boxes.name: Unstable Stack of Boxes
boxes.thought: Those boxes are stacked too high and they're tilting! They could fall over and injure someone.
boxes.description: A tall, tilting stack of boxes that could topple over.

puddle.name: Wet Puddle on Floor
puddle.thought: That puddle is a slipping hazard! Someone could easily lose their footing.
puddle.description: A wet puddle on the floor creating a slip-and-fall hazard.

chemicals_unlabeled.name: Unlabeled Chemicals
chemicals_unlabeled.thought: These chemical bottles have no labeling at all. Without knowing what's inside, nobody can handle them safely.
chemicals_unlabeled.description: Chemical bottles without proper labels, preventing safe handling.

chemicals_sunlight.name: Chemicals in Direct Sunlight
chemicals_sunlight.thought: Those chemicals are sitting in direct sunlight! Chemicals should never be stored where sunlight can reach them - it could cause dangerous reactions.
chemicals_sunlight.description: Chemical bottles stored in direct sunlight, risking degradation or dangerous reactions.

chemical_edge.name: Open Chemical at Shelf Edge
chemical_edge.thought: That open chemical bottle is right at the edge of the shelf. It could topple and spill at any moment!
chemical_edge.description: An open chemical bottle precariously placed at the edge of a shelf.

sandwich.name: Sandwich / Pest Risk
sandwich.thought: There's a sandwich left on the desk! Food left out like this will attract pests - look, I can already see ants nearby.
sandwich.description: An exposed sandwich on the desk attracting pests to the workspace.

bucket.name: Unhygienic Cleaning Bucket
bucket.thought: That cleaning bucket looks disgusting. Bacteria grows quickly in stagnant dirty water - this is a health hazard.
bucket.description: A dirty cleaning bucket with stagnant water, breeding bacteria.

gloves.name: Damaged Protection Gloves
gloves.thought: Those protective gloves are torn and damaged. They might not protect against chemicals or sharp objects anymore.
gloves.description: Worn and damaged protective gloves that no longer provide adequate protection.

labels.thought: These labels are a bit faded, but I can still see what it says. Not really a risk.

fragile_box.thought: This box is marked fragile but it's closed and stored securely on the shelf. It's fine.

taped_cable.thought: This cable is taped down to the floor. Good - it's fastened properly so nobody trips on it.

door_sign.thought: The door has a warning sign on it. That's actually a good safety measure - the situation is under control.

chair.thought: The chair is slightly pulled out from the desk. Not really a hazard.

riskAssessment.title: Risk Assessment Matrix
riskAssessment.instructions: For each identified risk, assess the Likelihood (1-5) and Impact (1-5). The Risk Score is calculated automatically.
riskAssessment.likelihoodTooltip: How likely is this hazard to occur? 1 = Very Unlikely, 2 = Unlikely, 3 = Possible, 4 = Likely, 5 = Very Likely
riskAssessment.impactTooltip: How severe would the consequences be? 1 = Negligible, 2 = Minor, 3 = Moderate, 4 = Major, 5 = Catastrophic
riskAssessment.riskScoreTooltip: Risk Score = Likelihood x Impact. Higher scores indicate greater risk priority.

review.title: Risk Assessment Review
review.generalFeedbackHigh: You tended to rate risks higher than expected. Remember that not every hazard is equally likely or severe.
review.generalFeedbackLow: You tended to underestimate risks. In workplace safety, it's important to take even moderate hazards seriously.
review.perfectScore: Excellent work! All risks were assessed within acceptable ranges.
review.goodScore: Good job! Most of your assessments were on target.

completion.title: Congratulations!
completion.message: You have successfully identified all workplace hazards and completed a thorough risk assessment. You've demonstrated strong risk management skills - the ability to spot dangers and evaluate them systematically is crucial in any workplace!
completion.revealedNote: That one needed the answer shown, so it is worth going over this part in the module.

hints.intro: Look around the room carefully. Click on objects that look dangerous or out of place.
hints.identifying: There are still risks to find. Look for electrical hazards, chemical storage issues, structural dangers, and hygiene problems.
hints.assessment: Rate each risk's likelihood and impact. Think about how often this could happen and how bad the consequences would be.
hints.review: Review your assessment results and click 'End Risk Assessment' when ready.
hints.allRisksFound: You've found all the risks. Click the whiteboard on the left wall to start the risk assessment.
hints.whiteboardZoom: Click the assessment table on the whiteboard to begin.
hints.default: Look around the room for potential hazards.
